name: The quiet push
summary: A change skips the canary procedure that most changes follow, its alerts go to a channel nobody watches, and it is sent to every depot at once.
safe_pattern: Canary batch first, and route the system's alerts to a watched channel with an owner.

conditions.text: Other changes follow a staged procedure

citations.quote: Most changes at Tern & Tally go through the canary procedure: a small batch of depots first, then everyone.

conditions.text: This change does not follow it

citations.quote: This change did not follow the canary procedure.

conditions.text: The system's alerts go to a channel

citations.quote: The printer error alerts went to the printer-alerts email list.

conditions.text: Nobody active is watching that channel

citations.quote: Nobody was watching the printer-alerts email list, so the alerts went unread for more than three hours.

conditions.text: The change goes to every depot at once

citations.quote: The firmware was sent to every depot at once, so every depot failed together.
